source_reference.author: Gabriel Landini
source_reference.title: EVA Alphabet Font Version 2 Reference
source_reference.role: documented connectivity spellings and historical alphabet comparisons; does not settle semantic or manuscript-glyph units

processing.segmentation: case-sensitive left-to-right longest match; ties sorted lexically; unmatched ASCII letters each emit one segment; never cross token boundaries
processing.measurement: same equal-locus initial-minus-rest contrast as the baseline, using emitted segment counts per original token
processing.pairing: same 2,000 token-index draws as the baseline in every source/spacing variant, paired across unit policies

policies.unit: one listed bench sequence, otherwise one unmatched ASCII letter
one listed bench or minim sequence, otherwise one unmatched ASCII letter

null.definition: independently choose a uniformly random token as first within each fixed locus; remaining tokens retain their multiset
null.randomness: JSON-encoded seed/source/policy/locus context plus 16-byte big-endian replicate counter; shared HashDraws rejection sampling

inference_limit: These are analyst-declared segment counts, not manuscript glyph counts, a complete Currier conversion, phonetic units, a language test, or independent validation. All three policies must be reported without choosing a preferred map from the result.
